description: This file defines the ImageWidget class for Drupal, implementing a custom field widget for image fields with preview and validation features.

classes.name: ImageWidget
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class implementing a custom image field widget with preview and validation features.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the ImageWidget class, initializing services and dependencies.

methods.name: defaultSettings
methods.description: Returns default settings for the widget, including progress indicator and preview style.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Builds the settings form for configuring the widget, including preview image style options.

methods.name: settingsSummary
methods.description: Provides a summary of current widget settings, especially the preview image style.

methods.name: formMultipleElements
methods.description: Creates form elements for multiple file uploads, with help text and description handling.

methods.name: formElement
methods.description: Builds the form element for a single image upload, including validation and default image handling.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes the image widget form element, adding image preview, alt, and title fields.

methods.name: validateRequiredFields
methods.description: Validation callback for alt and title fields if marked as required.

methods.name: calculateDependencies
methods.description: Calculates configuration dependencies, especially related to image styles.

methods.name: onDependencyRemoval
methods.description: Handles removal of dependencies, updating image style settings accordingly.

methods.name: errorElement
methods.description: Custom error element handling for validation errors.
